raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: Misidentification of Historical Figures and Improper Synthesis of Evidence. The Planner incorrectly inferred that "Chian Hsiao-chang" refers to "Chiang Hsiao-chang" (the daughter of Chiang Ching-kuo) despite the search results explicitly stating the name is "Chiang Hsiao-chang" and the user query spelling it as "Chian". More critically, the Planner hallucinated a generational link, claiming Chiang Ching-kuo is the son of Chiang Kai-shek (which is true) but then erroneously concluded that the "other child" of the father (Chiang Ching-kuo) is Chiang Wei-kuo. Chiang Wei-kuo is the brother of Chiang Ching-kuo, not the child of Chiang Ching-kuo. The Planner failed to correctly parse the family tree: The father of Chiang Hsiao-chang is Chiang Ching-kuo. The children of Chiang Ching-kuo are Chiang Hsiao-chang, Hsiao-wen, Hsiao-wu, and Hsiao-yung. The Planner confused the generation, treating Chiang Wei-kuo (Chiang Ching-kuo's brother) as a child of Chiang Ching-kuo.
